scripts.build: bun run --filter @imgflow/api build && bun run --filter @imgflow/web build && bun run --filter @imgflow/cdk build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @imgflow/api typecheck && bun run --filter @imgflow/web typecheck && bun run --filter @imgflow/cdk typecheck && bun run --filter @imgflow/integration-tests typecheck && bun run --cwd services/api tsc -p ../../scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: oxfmt apps/web services/api infra/cdk tests/integration scripts/deploy-web.ts scripts/tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check apps/web services/api infra/cdk tests/integration scripts/deploy-web.ts scripts/tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps/web services/api infra/cdk tests/integration scripts/deploy-web.ts
scripts.test: bun test apps/web/src services/api/test && bun run --filter @imgflow/cdk test
